prompt: Decompose for a non-specialist reader, without losing any facts: 'The network reaches consensus via a Byzantine fault-tolerant protocol that tolerates up to f faulty nodes out of 3f+1.'
reference_facts: Byzantine fault tolerance means the system keeps working correctly even if some nodes send conflicting or malicious messages.
Consensus means all honest nodes agree on the same result.
The protocol tolerates up to f faulty nodes as long as the total node count is at least 3f+1.
